summary: Quiet street near the cul-de-sac head, homes 16 m away, steep.

best_section.where: East kerb near the head of Charlane Avenue, before the turning circle

drivers.seclusion: Homes 16-18 m away on the same side; dwellings at 7-10 m elsewhere on this kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; cars park on it, so a van fits at the kerb.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along the street, so a van would not stand out much.

flags: Steep: about 9% on the section, 12.6% max over the stretch
Homes within 25 m on own side
Dwellings 7-10 m away along most of this kerb
sun_shade: Garden trees shade the east side in places; open from the west.
